Fractal North ITX

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1979514-fractal-north-itx?from=search#profileId-2129229

I’ve always loved the design of the Fractal North, but as a big fan of ITX builds, I wanted to combine the best of both worlds… So here it is, the very first Fractal North ITX, designed and built by myself, a true ITX enthusiast. 

 

If you want to recreate this build, you’ll definitely need the Gigabyte RTX 5060 Low Profile, a Flex PSU (links below) and of course an ITX Motherboard. For the CPU, you’ve got around 73mm of clearance for your cooler.

 

 

Hardware :

 

* TINMORRY Carbon Fiber PETG Filament https://amzn.to/3V3gbyo
* Wooden PLA https://amzn.to/47W658S
* 6mm M3 Hex Screw https://amzn.to/4nLv2tc 
* M3x4x5mm Heat Insert https://amzn.to/4hTc82j 
* Power Button ( 12mm ) https://amzn.to/4g35mGc 
* 2x USB to 19 Pin https://amzn.to/486Jfwk
Step By Step Guide :

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 4 walls, 25% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 4
- Infill: 25%
- Filament: PETG-CF (#161616)
